purpose: Immutable source-review input for an experimental default-OFF exact Q6_K output-head component-plane cache.

dispatch.route: Q6 vector product; exact shape, no gather, row zero, Store, BF16; all other shapes/types/routes fall back to canonical weight
dispatch.activation_and_arithmetic: existing canonical q8 activation path, decoder integer mapping, FP32 dot chain/reduction and BF16 store retained
dispatch.storage: separate model-owned DeviceSpan; not represented as a GGUF block type; Binder adds full auxiliary and alignment to arena capacity before DeviceArena allocation; allocation failure aborts load
dispatch.lifetime: MaterializedArtifact owns backing allocation; Model exposes the span, and parameters attach it only to the canonical text output-head Weight

transform: For each Q6_K block (210B): copy ql[128], qh[64], scales[16], d[2] into row planes at offsets 0,2560,3840,4160; 20 blocks per K5120 row; output row 4224B; full extra bytes accounted.

tests.cpu_byte_oracle: three-row exact canonical block-byte pack/unpack round trip
tests.operator_regression: feature-only CTest command requires the real full-head file; CMake checks pinned SHA 2155d6e1f7c5549077438c4760e6e150945dd5e406484b29162dff7b03d05da0; T1/T4 N248320/K5120; canonical baseline output compared byte-exactly with candidate for eager and captured graph; candidate trailing canary checked after both
tests.actual_runtime_model_route: not established by source-only operator harness

review_focus: plane addressing and exact math order
capacity accounting, lifetime, fallback and default-OFF integration
real-fixture CTest/eager-graph/canary coverage and dispatch guards

patch.note: The new untracked helper header is covered by the file hash list below rather than git diff output.

risks: A complete 1.0489GB second device-resident copy is a substantial startup and VRAM admission cost; this is not a speed claim.

Allocation is accounted in MaterializationPlan and must fit as one arena allocation; subsequent runtime KV admission observes post-model free memory and may reject fixed capacity rather than silently shrinking it.
Source-level correctness and CPU pack/unpack do not prove compiled/runtime bit equality, real production model routing, or acceleration.
